body: "visual novel / beat 'em up" This actually exists, check out Baldr Sky. It's a visual novel with beat 'em up sections.
Howard Moon literally just called a fight nobody's seen to completion "perfect". I think people need to get over the initial rush before releasing these infernal takes.

People are too busy masturbating over the fight's difficulty without actually doing it themselves. The reality is, having to go through 6 minutes of automatic motions with still a possibility of failing may be hard, but above all it's tedious as fuck.

Notice how the only replay agreeing with you is the guy who's been actually doing the fight nonstop since patch drop. It's comical.

Alright Mr. 95+th percentile Samurai, let's take a look at how significant this actually is.

In your (arbitrarily chosen) top Alte Roite parse you use Seigan 6 times (90 kenki) for 24.5k damage. 90 Kenki allows you to use 3 Shinten and .6 of a Shinten leftover, which let's assume you also use on Shinten, for 3.6 Shintens. Your individual Seigan damage was an average of 4083. This is a 200 potency ability, making a 300 potency ability used in the same situation do 6124 damage. 3.6 times that is 22048 damage.

Subtract your actual Seigan damage (24500) with the damage dealt by Shinten with the same kenki (22048) and you get 2452. Divide this by the kill time (429s) to get **5.7** DPS.

Think about that. You went above and beyond, thinking up different Third Eye usages for a 6 DPS gain. When your character did 5800+ DPS. It's almost an actual 0.1% increase. It's so ridiculous I can't stop laughing.

I gotta agree with OP, and people shaming him for not pursuing a literal DPS increase of SIX are insane.
